But as the epochs vanished behind him, the selfish ways of his father--the ways of many amongst his godly kin, they who judged him despicable--eventually began to ring hollow. War for its own sake was no longer enough to satisfy his desires. For the first time in his ageless days, the god of war began to question to what ends he swung his glorious spear.

As the Fates would have it, his solution came easily: he must wage war for a larger purpose, and inspire more than mere savagery and sorrow at the sight of his crest. He must at last lay claim to the mantle of leadership that is his birthright, for the time has come to burn down the pantheon of the old age and build a just new empire atop the ashes of his kin. In real life, this is the same name given to the Roman god Mars by the emperor [[wikipedia:augustus|Caesar Augustus]] when he created a cult of the same name. Mars Ultor means "Mars the Avenger" in Latin. ** Mars' Immortal Off-hand item, {{Cl|ability|Mars God's Rebuke|God's Mercy}}, references elements from the Greek Myth as well, namely [[wikipedia:Perseus|Perseus]] and [[wikipedia:Medusa|Medusa]]. Perseus (who is another one of the Greek god Zeus' sons) uses a polished shield to act as a mirror to approach and behead the sleeping {{H|Medusa}} without looking directly at her eyes, thereby avoiding her infamous stone gaze. Perseus also used Medusa's head as a weapon to turn King Atlas into stone. * Mars carries a Greek-style [[wikipedia:Boeotian shield|Boeotian shield]], but its decorative thunderbolts are more common on [[wikipedia:Scutum (shield)|Roman shields]]. * weapons_hero_mars_enc_arena_of_blood.mp3 {{A|Mars|Arena of Blood}}'s sound comes from the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jmk5frp6-3Q&t=257 "Mars"] movement of [[wikipedia:Gustav Holst|Gustav Holst]]'s musical suite, "[[wikipedia:The Planets|The Planets]]". Mars also vo_mars_mars_song_01.mp3 hums the music when ordered to move or after killing an enemy in the Arena of Blood. * Mars' response on pinning an enemy against the walls of Arena of Blood vo_mars_mars_ability1_16.mp3 "Are you not entertained?!" is a reference to a scene from the film [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YbBiXPVKuTA&t=1m25s "Gladiator"]. * vo_mars_mars_death_20.mp3 "What is this madness?!" and Dota Plus chat wheel line vo_mars_mars_wheel_all_11.mp3 "THIS IS DOOOOTAAAAA!" are references to the famous "THIS IS SPARTA!" scene from the film [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cAacE5ukzrs&t=176 "300"] * vo_mars_mars_attack_21.mp3 "Mars the Impaler!")is a reference to [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vlad_the_Impaler Vlad the Impaler], the Wallachian Voivode who was the inspiration behind [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bram_Stoker Bram Stoker]'s [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dracula Count Dracula]. * Mars' rare Arena of Blood cast response vo_mars_mars_ability4_10.mp3 "WITNESS MEEEE!" is a reference to a War Boy's suicide attack using grenade-tipped spears from the film [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AS2Oliv7p3w "Mad Max: Fury Road"]. * Files related to Mars were leaked on [[January 03, 2018 Patch|January 03, 2018]], but were deleted later that day.
